title: Competing influences
hook: Explore the evidence behind a cosmic question.

knows: Light and gravity help astronomers study the universe.
doesNotKnow: Cosmic expansion describes the large-scale evolution of space. Gravity can nevertheless bind galaxies, clusters and other local structures under suitable conditions.

misconception: A learner may choose: No: expansion forbids all gravitational structures
objective: Use the visual model to reason about: Can gravity gather matter into galaxies while the universe expands on large scales?

claims.text: Question, correct answer and explanation: Can gravity gather matter into galaxies while the universe expands on large scales? Yes: gravity can bind local structures even as large-scale space expands. Cosmic expansion describes the large-scale evolution of space. Gravity can nevertheless bind galaxies, clusters and other local structures under suitable conditions.
Visual caption: Local binding, cosmic growth. The SVG is a conceptual illustration, not measured data or a scale model.
